@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+import logging
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+
+from structlog.stdlib import ProcessorFormatter
+
+
+class DistinctiveFormatter(ProcessorFormatter):
+    def formatException(self, exc_info):
+        self.exception_calls.append(exc_info)
+        return f"own exception: {exc_info[1]}"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("keep", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("structured", [True, False])
+def test_cached_exception_rendering(keep, structured):
+    try:
+        raise ValueError("broken")
+    except ValueError:
+        exc_info = sys.exc_info()
+
+    if structured:
+        event_dict = {"event": "hello world", "exc_info": exc_info}
+        args, kwargs = ProcessorFormatter.wrap_for_formatter(
+            logging.getLogger("cached-exception"), "error", event_dict
+        )
+        record = logging.LogRecord(
+            "cached-exception", logging.ERROR,
+            __file__, 1, args[0], (), exc_info,
+        )
+        record.__dict__.update(kwargs["extra"])
+    else:
+        record = logging.LogRecord(
+            "cached-exception", logging.ERROR,
+            __file__, 1, "hello %s", ("world",), exc_info,
+        )
+
+    record.exc_text = "earlier handler exception"
+    original = record.__dict__.copy()
+    original_message = record.msg.copy() if structured else record.msg
+
+    formatter = DistinctiveFormatter(
+        processors=[lambda logger, name, ed: ed["event"] + " [processed]"],
+        keep_exc_info=keep,
+    )
+    formatter.exception_calls = []
+    expected = "hello world [processed]"
+    if keep:
+        expected += "\nown exception: broken"
+
+    assert formatter.format(record) == expected
+    assert record.__dict__ == original
+    assert record.msg == original_message
+    assert record.exc_info is exc_info
+    assert record.exc_text == "earlier handler exception"
+    assert formatter.exception_calls == ([exc_info] if keep else [])
+
+    assert formatter.format(record) == expected
+    assert record.__dict__ == original
+    assert record.msg == original_message
+    assert formatter.exception_calls == ([exc_info, exc_info] if keep else [])
